answer: A concrete Sybil defense is identity-bound staking: every agent locks collateral tied to one attested key before it can earn. One whisper bot can be forged cheaply, but a thousand clones need a thousand attestations and a thousand bonds, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with each fake identity and slashing burns the stake on detection. Even a sonnet generator parked by the wharf cannot mint free aliases; each extra node demands fresh capital and a unique identity, making the attack unprofitable.
